purpose: Quick machine-readable index of project surfaces, canonical files, and AI Brain workflows for future agents.

rules: Use context-pack --limit 5 before broad scans for non-trivial work.
Use proof sessions when claiming the brain helped.
Keep localaibrain/brain local; track commander, scripts, instructions, skill shims, and pointers.

grillWithDocs.when: Non-trivial planning, terminology, architecture, or documentation work.
rules: Check Local AI Brain and pointers first.
Answer questions from code/docs when possible.
Ask unresolved design questions one at a time with a recommended answer.
Update project-context/CONTEXT.md only as a glossary after terms are resolved.
Create ADRs only for hard-to-reverse, surprising trade-offs.
Save the handoff to the OS temp directory.
Record a sanitized copy into Local AI Brain with artifact_type=handoff.
Reference existing artifacts instead of duplicating them.

docs.caution: LLM.md contains useful brain-file-map ideas but some paths reference an older Ourstuff layout; verify paths before use.

keyTerms.Local AI Brain: Project-local searchable memory and artifact store under localaibrain.
keyTerms.Agent Alignment: Project-wide operating agreement in project-context/AGENT_ALIGNMENT.md for how future agents use instructions, pointers, Local AI Brain, handoffs, and Codex setup.
keyTerms.Pointer: Short durable index entry under project-context/pointers linking terms, surfaces, workflows, and canonical files.
keyTerms.Context pack: Compact Local AI Brain retrieval result used before broad repo scans.
keyTerms.Proof session: Local AI Brain audit trail for whether memory retrieval helped.
keyTerms.Handoff artifact: Compact session summary generated by $handoff, saved to OS temp, then recorded into Local AI Brain.
keyTerms.project-context/CONTEXT.md: Domain glossary only; create lazily when a real term is resolved.
keyTerms.ADR: Decision record for hard-to-reverse, surprising trade-offs.
